question: Has anyone died in outer space?
short_answer: Three Soviet cosmonauts (Georgi Dobrovolski, Viktor Patsayev, and Vladislav Volkov) died in outer space in 1971 when Soyuz 11 depressurized during re-entry preparation above 100 km.
